entities.summary: David Hotel, a notable figure in the history of Israel, associated with British Mandate Palestine (1939–1948). Preceded by WWII, Holocaust, and End of Mandate and Arab Revolt against British rule and Jewish immigration. Their legacy influenced UN General Assembly votes for partition of Palestine into Jewish and Arab states.
